g.text: Complete circuit on one sheet: TLC555 + speed trim pot + CD4017 + five LEDs. No sensors or transistors.
GND / supply negative - all blue ground connections are common

g.text: P1 sets the LED step interval: approximately 0.2-1.6 seconds. This first test runs continuously.
All five LED resistors are 10k: deliberately low current and low brightness. C3 positive is at the top.
Dots mean joined wires. Pin positions are functional: use the pin NUMBERS on the actual DIP packages.
Leave CD4017 pins 5, 6, 9, 11 and 12 open. Startup may begin mid-sequence; then it settles into five steps.
Stage 1 v0.1 | 2026-10-22 | Datasheet-checked design; not yet hardware-tested.
Sources: TI TLC555 SLFS043K and TI CD4017B SCHS027C. Place C1 and C2 next to their respective ICs.
